clues: Formed in 2023, this artificial intelligence lab focuses on post-training open-weight models.
It developed YaRN to expand context windows at lower compute costs, along with synthetic dataset tools like DataForge.
It first gained attention by fine-tuning Meta's open-source Llama architectures around user alignment.
Led by CEO Dillon Rolnick, it aims to build an open, auditable alternative to closed proprietary ecosystems.
Executions of its flagship software agent are estimated to drive roughly 2.5% of all AI token usage globally.
This startup behind the Hermes agent family recently raised $90 million in Series B funding at a $1.5 billion valuation.
